scheme_name: Pathari Kshetr Talab Nirman Aadharit Matsya Paalan ki Yojana
other_conditions: Must own or lease land in the identified plateau‑dominated districts.
Must construct a pond with a maximum of one acre and a minimum water area of 0.4‑acre (i.e., 0.5‑acre area).
Must install a concrete board on the pond, made of an iron sheet sized 4 ft × 3 ft, standing four feet at an iron angle, with the description written in paint.
benefits_summary: Provides up to 80 % subsidy (up to ₹16.70 lakh per acre) payable in two installments: 60 % after pond construction and 40 % after installation of related units and purchase of inputs.
